name: drawer
summary: Slide-in side panel (from the right) for detail views, edit forms, and record-contextual content. The product's MOST-used overlay (FlotoDrawer 99x + FlotoDrawerForm 59x = 158x). Open via open prop or trigger slot.

FlotoDrawerForm.summary: FlotoForm (vertical) + FlotoDrawer; suppresses MForm default Submit so only the footer submits

behaviors.close: built-in x (Ant a-drawer) + actions footer + Escape — maskClosable:false (no backdrop-close)
behaviors.scroll: body scrolls (FlotoScrollView); title/footer pinned; ~65px reserved at bottom when actions slot present

accessibility.semantics: role=dialog, focus trap, BUILT-IN close x (better than MModal which has none), Escape closes

decisionFlow: Short yes/no or destructive confirmation? -> FlotoConfirmModal, not a drawer.
Long content, a detail view, or a form contextual to a record? -> FlotoDrawer.
An Add/Edit FORM in a panel? -> FlotoDrawerForm (vertical form + validation + footer submit).
A short focused task that must center-interrupt? -> MModal (dialog).

detail(FlotoDrawer).useWhen: view details / long content contextual to a record
detail(FlotoDrawer).example: incident details, view-detail/view-more drawers, gauge/compliance drilldown

form(FlotoDrawerForm).useWhen: Add/Edit form in a panel (vertical form + validation; footer Save submits)
form(FlotoDrawerForm).example: most Add/Edit flows; approval drawers (sync/runbook/firmware), email-dispatch form

width.useWhen: default 40%; narrower (px) for simple panels, wider (%) for rich content

large-fullscreen(85-96%).useWhen: complex MULTI-PANE flows (left nav + main form + right reference panel) — config/registration wizards
large-fullscreen(85-96%).example: APM Application Registration (width=96%); used ~30x at 90%/96%/85%/100%. Use a wide drawer, not a modal.

FlotoDrawer.useWhen: You need a slide-in side panel to show the details of a record, or long/rich content contextual to the current context. Open it via the `open` prop (use .sync) or a `trigger` slot; give it a `title`, a scrollable body, and an `actions` footer with `{ hide }`. Default `width` is 40% — narrow to 360px for simple panels, widen to 50-70% for richer editors, or 85-96% for large multi-pane flows (left nav + main form + right reference panel) like config/registration wizards. It's the product's most-used overlay (99x).
FlotoDrawer.dontUse: Not for a short yes/no or destructive confirmation (use FlotoConfirmModal), nor a short focused task that should center-interrupt (use MModal). If the panel's whole purpose is an Add/Edit form with validation and a footer Save, reach for FlotoDrawerForm instead so MForm's default Submit is suppressed. Don't rely on backdrop-click to close (maskClosable:false) — use the built-in x or a footer Cancel.
FlotoDrawer.example: Incident details panel; view-detail / view-more drawers; gauge / compliance drilldown; credential / catalog selection drawers; APM Application Registration at width=96% (a wide multi-pane drawer, not a modal).

FlotoDrawerForm.useWhen: The panel is an Add/Edit FORM. It wraps a vertical FlotoForm with validation inside the drawer and suppresses MForm's default Submit so only the footer Save submits. Provide a `header` (title), fields in the body, and an `actions` footer exposing `{ hide, submit }`. Same open / width / scrolledContent props as FlotoDrawer (59x usage).
FlotoDrawerForm.dontUse: Not for a read-only detail view or non-form content — use plain FlotoDrawer there. Not for a short confirmation (FlotoConfirmModal) or a small center-interrupting task (MModal). Don't hand-roll a bare MForm inside a FlotoDrawer without suppressing its default Submit, or you get two submit buttons — that's exactly what FlotoDrawerForm solves.
FlotoDrawerForm.example: Most Add/Edit flows across the product; sync / runbook / firmware-upgrade approval drawers; attach-rules / attach-storage; the email-dispatch form.

large (multi-pane, 85-96%).useWhen: a rich configuration/registration WIZARD that needs multiple panes (nav + form + info) side by side; too much for a form drawer
large (multi-pane, 85-96%).example: APM Application Registration; multi-pane setup wizards. Use width 85-96% + scrolled-content=false so each column scrolls independently. NOT a modal.

left placement.useWhen: a filter or secondary-nav side sheet that conceptually belongs on the LEFT (not a record detail)
left placement.example: faceted filter panel, left nav drawer. Set placement="left".

footer=close.useWhen: a READ-ONLY detail drawer — nothing to submit, just dismiss
footer=close.example: view monitor details, drilldown. Single Close button.

footer=cancel-save.useWhen: the STANDARD Add/Edit form — one primary commit
footer=cancel-save.example: add/edit a record. Cancel (left) + Save (primary, far right).

footer=reset-cancel-save.useWhen: a form where RESET-to-defaults is a common need (filters, config, thresholds)
footer=reset-cancel-save.example: filter/config drawers. Reset + Cancel + Save, all right-aligned.

footer=delete-split.useWhen: an EDIT drawer where DELETING the record is a primary, destructive action that must be visually separated from Save
footer=delete-split.example: edit + delete a policy/monitor. Delete (error outline) on the LEFT via justify-between; Cancel + Save on the right.

footer=note-split.useWhen: a multi-step form (needs Back) or a form that must surface a mandatory-fields note on the left
footer=note-split.example: wizard step, mandatory-field form. Note or Back on the LEFT; confirm group (Cancel/Save) on the right. 4+ actions → move extras into a menu.

inset-alignment.useWhen: the heading, body and footer share ONE horizontal inset (--drawer-inset, default 15px) so they ALIGN. Set the `--drawer-inset` custom property on the drawer for any value; `use-padding` bumps all three to 24px together.
inset-alignment.dontUse: expecting `use-padding` to pad only the body — it now widens the WHOLE panel (header+body+footer) so they stay aligned.
inset-alignment.example: <obs-drawer style="--drawer-inset: 20px"> aligns all three regions at 20px; use-padding → 24px

inProduct.FlotoDrawer: IncidentDetails, ViewDetail/ViewMore, Gauge/Compliance drilldown, Credential/Catalog selection drawers

do: Use a Drawer for detail views, edit forms, long/record-contextual content.
Use FlotoDrawerForm for Add/Edit forms (vertical form + footer submit).
Put actions in the footer (Cancel left, Save right).
dont: Don't use a Drawer for a short confirmation (use FlotoConfirmModal).
Don't rely on backdrop-click to close (disabled) — use the x or footer Cancel.
Don't add an MForm inside without suppressing its default Submit (two submit buttons).
whenToUse: Detail views, edit forms, and long/record-contextual content that doesn't fit a centered modal.

title.note: header title text (or use the `title` slot)

mask-closable.note: product default: clicking the backdrop does NOT close

scrolled-content.note: wrap body in a scroll region; false = multi-pane (columns scroll independently)

footer.note: built-in footer action pattern, rendered from obs-buttons when the actions slot is EMPTY. Cancel/Close close the drawer; Save/Reset/Delete/Back emit a footer-action event with {action}. Provide the actions slot to fully customise instead.

knownIssues: [element] obs-drawer (web component) is FUNCTIONAL: native <dialog> showModal → top-layer render, focus-trap + Esc for free. `open` reflects to el.open; ✕ / Esc / a slotted [data-close] element emit `close` then `after-close` (~slide-out). Slots: default (scrollable body), `title`, `actions` (60px footer). Backdrop is BLUR-ONLY and inert (mask-closable=false by default). Right or left placement. Imperative el.show() / el.hide(). Diff-gated vs the real FlotoDrawer (header/title/panel, light+dark).
F1 (low): @hide emits ~500ms after close (setTimeout for the slide-out animation) — parents should account for the delay.
F2 (high, a11y): no visible focus ring inside the panel (SF-001).

F3 (low): .actions footer is justify-end with NO gap -> adjacent buttons touch (0px). Product convention is mr-2 on the non-last button. Fix: add gap:8px to .actions in drawer.less. Footer layout: 2=Cancel(mr-2)+Save right; 3=Reset/Cancel/Save right OR destructive left + confirm group right (justify-between); 4=tertiary/note left + confirm group right; primary far-right, Cancel just left of it, destructive/tertiary on the left.
changelog: 2026-08-10 — Inset alignment (consumer G19): heading, body AND footer now share ONE horizontal inset via the `--drawer-inset` custom property (default 15px) — the footer was hardcoded to 24px with no knob, so the three regions could never line up. `use-padding` now widens the WHOLE panel to 24px (was body-only), and consumers can set `--drawer-inset` directly (like --drawer-background-color). Verified all three align at 15/24/custom.
